Based on the failed “addr_li referenced before declaration” pattern in the 1 RW synchronizer with mask‐write “from 1R1W,” the primary fix lives in:

1) bsg_mem_1rw_sync_mask_write_bit_from_1r1w.sv

However, we want to make sure we catch the same pattern in all of its “from 1R1W” variants.  In this directory those are:

2) bsg_mem_1rw_sync_mask_write_byte_from_1r1w.sv  
3) bsg_mem_1rw_sync_mask_write_from_1r1w.sv  

It also makes sense to update the non-“from 1R1W” bit and byte mask-write modules so they’re consistent:

4) bsg_mem_1rw_sync_mask_write_bit.sv
